Interface StreamingHttpOutputMessage

All Superinterfaces:
HttpMessage, HttpOutputMessage
public interface StreamingHttpOutputMessage extends HttpOutputMessage
Contract for HttpOutputMessage implementations to expose the ability to stream request body content by writing to an OutputStream from a callback.

`setBody(Body)` 方法提供了流式传输的选项，且与 `HttpOutputMessage.getBody()` 互斥使用；后者返回一个在发送请求体之前聚合请求体的 `OutputStream`。

Since:
4.0
Author:
Arjen Poutsma, Rossen Stoyanchev
